title: Critter Crisis approved preview
status: Approved preview saved locally; do not upload or install until requested.
features: Phone aim wheel and cover/reload controls
Fixed land cover exists before enemy entry and remains after defeat
Enemies enter exposed, move to predetermined cover, duck and peek; cover blocks hits
Boat chase uses boat hulls and player bow for cover; no crates on boats
Detailed weapon pickup and first-person art
SMG earned after 3 defeats; shotgun earned after 6 defeats
Shoot earned weapon drops to equip; no manual switching
SMG full auto while FIRE, mouse, or F is held
Yard, reactor, docks and boat chase previews; two areas per encounter
Mouse Frontier modes excluded from the Critter Crisis preview menu
limitations: This is the approved interactive preview, not a newly built Android APK.
The 2-player selection previews the layout; this HTML does not implement LAN networking.
Production Lua integration and Android packaging remain separate work.
